demo.program:
# Verilog — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created Verilog?", "Phil Moorby"),
    ("What paradigm is Verilog?", "hardware description"),
    ("What is creator?", "Phil Moorby"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "1984"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "hardware description"),
    ("What is typing?", "static"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".v"),
    ("What is hello world?", "// hello via $display in testbench"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
